        {#if !comparisonUnavailable}<RepositoryRevisionFiles
            {copyText}
            {state}
            {controller}
            {onOpenDiff}
            {comparisonTargets}
            {comparisonLabel}
            separateActions={!hasMessageBody &&
              Boolean(
                onOpenEvolution ||
                onRestoreVault ||
                (state.revision?.conflicted && onResolveConflicts),
              )}
          />{/if}{/snippet}
    </RepositoryGraph>{/if}

      size="sm"
      disabled={state.busy}
